rules: Only tracked Markdown under docs may become a public page.
Internal audit, status, and implementation notes listed in excluded_markdown do not become public pages.
Only locally linked files under docs/resources may be copied into the site.
Authenticated Canvas, H&L, FYF, Xello, Climber Notes, and private AVID assets never enter the public build.
A missing, outside-root, or protected local link fails the build instead of being silently copied.
